environment: .NET SDK 10.0.303; FFmpeg/ffprobe 9.0.1 full_shared; Windows x64; Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium

determinism.command: dotnet run -c Release -- webproof; node web/encoder.test.cjs
determinism.detail: All core assertions and 32 gallery format/binding repeat/decode pairs passed. Twelve independent data-sequence MP4 renders matched.
determinism.packaging: Two fresh builds reproduced every media, thumbnail and scene-data byte. Final frontend change only stacked overlapping timeline spans; checksums regenerated.

browser.detail: Seven demos, 18 bindings, 36 exports, sample switching, exact scenes/source, timeline, keyboard seeking, playback, three responsive widths and errors. Local MP4/WebM/WAV/MP3 selection, parameter updates, invalid/oversized/short inputs, repeated export, cancellation, reset and shutdown cleanup.

limits: Static public gallery; arbitrary parameters and personal media require the optional loopback workbench. 50 MiB per file; generated session paths. No production API/CLI integration. Same-environment repeatability; x264 cpu-independent mode changes some older Lab MP4 bytes. See web/README.md and web/VALIDATION.md.
